description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for git bundle functionalities, including creation, verification, fetching, cloning, and handling various bundle scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting success with a specified description.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in the output.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a given path is missing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the current repository.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the fake clock used in tests.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after tests are complete.

methods.name: test_oid
methods.description: Retrieves object IDs or version info.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the conclusion of the test script.
